newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks seen rising on positive sentiment.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks seen rising on positive sentiment.

text.p: Dhaka Stocks are seen rising on Wednesday, supported by buying pressure after a series of corrections and state-owned Investment Corporation of Bangladesh (ICB) extending credit to investors, brokers said.

"The buyers are returning back as the scrips are very attractive after the corrections. The market sentiment is strong as the ICB has started giving loans for buying shares," said broker Moshtaqu Ahmed. Leather, engineering, food and pharmaceutical scrips may be attractive, said another broker.
The DSE all-share price index closed 39.64 points or 2.76 percent up at 1,473.84 on a turnover of 238.5 million taka.
